# Historical 150-model experiment inputs

This directory is retained for older verifier/package prerequisites.
It is not the current distribution. Use
[USERCAP_R10](../USERCAP_R10/README.md) and
[CONFIGURATION.md](../../CONFIGURATION.md) for installation and limits.

Superseded notes and unreferenced logs/dumps were archived byte-for-byte under
[the 2026-11-18 archive](../../archive/retired_2026-11-18/README.md).
Named verifier inputs remain here intentionally. Do not enable these old ASIs
alongside the current traffic-extension ASI.
